cl_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The CL pin for the Inkplate display. Defaults to GPIO0.

custom_waveform.docs:
**int**: Sets a custom predefined waveform for the display. Accepts values from 1 to 4. Useful if the greyscale of the image seems washed. **Inkplate10 ONLY**. Defaults to `0`

*See also: [Inkplate 5, 6, 10 and 6 Plus](https://esphome.io/components/display/inkplate#configuration-variables)*

*See also: [Inkplate 5, 6, 10 and 6 Plus](https://esphome.io/components/display/inkplate#configuration-variables)*

**boolean**: Makes the screen display 3 bit colors. Defaults to `false`

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

model.docs:

partial_updating.docs:
**boolean**: Makes the screen update partially, which is faster, but leaves burnin. Defaults to `false`

*See also: [Inkplate 5, 6, 10 and 6 Plus](https://esphome.io/components/display/inkplate#configuration-variables)*

transform.docs:
Transform the display presentation.

*See also: [Inkplate 5, 6, 10 and 6 Plus](https://esphome.io/components/display/inkplate#configuration-variables)*

lambda.docs:

*See also: [Inkplate 5, 6, 10 and 6 Plus](https://esphome.io/components/display/inkplate#configuration-variables)*

pages.docs:
**list**: Show pages instead of a single lambda. See [Display Pages](https://esphome.io/components/display#display-pages).
